$meta.source: DEFEX-Brand workspace · tokens/*.css · DEFEX Brand Kit.dc.html
notes: One accent colour only: Electric Blue. If it looks too blue, it is.
No emoji in product UI. Icons: Lucide, ~2px stroke.
Australian English, day-first dates, AUD with tabular numerals.
Wordmark: DEFEX with X in Electric Blue; ENGINEERING justified edge-to-edge beneath (flush D-to-X).
Mark: Option A 'Engineered' — X in rounded frame, blue diamond centre, uniform arms.

blue.usage: Electric Blue — actions, links, active nav, focus, progress, the diamond. PMS 2727 C

navy.usage: Navy Ink — wordmark, headings, dark surfaces. PMS 533 C

steel.usage: Secondary text, captions. PMS Cool Gray 9

blueprint.usage: Table headers, info panels, selected states

severity.usage: Report schedules / status only, always with a text label. Never decorative.

rules.headings: Navy Ink, tracking -0.02em; hero/display in Light 300, uppercase on marketing
rules.numerals: Tabular lining for money, hours, claims

effects.shadowBrand: soft blue lift on interactive-card hover
effects.motion: 0.2s ease global; entrances cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.3–0.8s; respect prefers-reduced-motion
effects.heroOverlay: navy→blue gradient over architectural photography for white text

voice.style: Plain, competent, Australian. Direct, specific, never salesy. No exclamation marks.
voice.casing: Marketing eyebrows ALL-CAPS wide-tracked; app copy Sentence case

company.abn: TBC — placeholder XXX XXX XXX XXX
company.credentials: BEng(Civil), MIEAust, CPEng, NER · NSW Registered Professional Engineer · NSW Registered Design Practitioner
